subject: Class 376 Electrostar, Southeastern, navy livery (2025-2026 refresh)
method: No usable side diagram (the Unisouth 376 drawing is a pixel copy of the 377's). Side positions: 1D projective fit along car 1 on p016 (3840 px) anchored on the orange ring's front edge (p026) and the DM length, with door heights constraining the perspective; cab door and cab-side window measured side-on on p026. Heights: p026 (side-on, 244 px/m) on the Electrostar bodyside heights (0.955 / 3.28). Face: p035 projective fit using its EXIF focal length (30 mm on APS-C, 2152 px), vertical scale 291 px/m from the yellow top (1.98 m, p026) and the face orange line. Every number has its source in `trace`.

projective.form: X = (a s + b)/(c s + 1), s metres back from the nose tip along the window-bottom line (p016 car 1)

p026.notes: cab door 182-750 px taken as 3.28-0.955 m (the 377's door span to the orange cantrail line); the photo is near-orthographic along the side (cantrail rows level within 4 px over 1400 px)

p035.notes: camera 28.6 deg off the face normal (fit of 6 symmetric pairs, rms 3.4 px); m = (X-x0) D / (F cos t - (X-x0) sin t), D = F/kV = 7.40 m; y from the local yellow-top row with scale F/(D + m sin t)

calibration.published: DM 19.95 m, MS/TS 19.69 m (Eversholt via Wikipedia infobox); doors 200 mm wider than earlier Electrostars, sliding into the bodyside (sremg.org.uk/emu/class376.shtml). No published door width found.
